cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We need measurements before moving the sofa. Are we shrinking while the room stays normal, or is the room growing while we stay normal?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Skip measuring, then. Shrinking means call full-sized help; growing means hurry before the door gets farther away. Choose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're shrinking. I'll call my brother.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him to bring tweezers. He'll need to collect us afterward.

reason: Make A abandon the initial measurement requirement in response to B urgency while keeping the explicit incompatible choice and its tweezers consequence.
